name: MarkItDown
summary: Python utility and CLI that converts PDF, Office documents, images, audio, HTML and other files to Markdown for use with LLMs.
use_cases: convert a PDF file to Markdown
prepare documents as Markdown for LLM text analysis pipelines
extract structured fields from invoices via Azure Content Understanding
features: convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel to Markdown
preserve headings, lists, tables and links

usage_guide.open_hint: Run `markitdown <file>` to print a file's contents as Markdown.

features.feature: convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel to Markdown
features.title: Convert PDF, Word, PowerPoint and Excel files to Markdown
steps: Run `markitdown <file>.pdf -o <output>.md` to save a PDF as a Markdown file.
Run `markitdown <file>.docx`, `markitdown <file>.xlsx` or `markitdown <file>.pptx` to print the Markdown to the terminal.

features.feature: preserve headings, lists, tables and links
features.title: Keep headings, lists, tables and links in the output
steps: Run `markitdown <file>.docx` to get headings, lists and tables as Markdown.
Run `markitdown <file>.html` to convert a web page, with links kept as Markdown links.

features.title: Add more file formats with third-party plugins

steps.purpose: create venv, pip install 'markitdown[all]', link markitdown into ~/.local/bin
create venv, pip install 'markitdown[all]', link markitdown into ~/.local/bin

Not needed; the SSH clone URL would also need a GitHub SSH key (https URL works without one)
No sample files are shipped; inputs were generated (python-docx is not part of markitdown[all], installed only to create the test .docx)

what_it_does.quote: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility for converting various files to Markdown for use with LLMs and related text analysis pipelines.

who_it_is_for.quote: This repository is intended to provide Python libraries that can be incorporated into other systems — not the end-user applications built on top of them.

install_per_os.quote: To install MarkItDown, use pip: `pip install 'markitdown[all]'`.

evidence.quote: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility for converting various files to Markdown for use with LLMs and related text analysis pipelines.
NOTE: Image captioning and speech transcription rely on web-hosted services.
